subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should this regression be fixed by preserving owner-scoped private access to `ssrf-runtime-internal`, or by making the managed-proxy helper part of a public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The import-only patch is mechanically invalid, and the plausible repair choices change the Plugin SDK/security boundary in different ways that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
options.body: Keep the helper private for Browser/Ollama and repair packaged resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Expose the helper through `ssrf-runtime` only with explicit docs, guardrails, tests, and security rationale.

options.title: Pick A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Pause or close duplicate candidate branches after maintainers choose one narrow repair direction for the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helper private for Browser/Ollama and repair packaged resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the private SDK/package boundary that this person recently hardened.
